question: Approve dispatch-and-report-hygiene's design (a Dispatch facts section every worker stage receives: FO signal name, package script path from the loaded skill, FAILED-only-when-unmet, one secret wrapper) and document the secret guard instead of shipping it?

artifacts.summary: Workers learn the four dispatch facts from the package; script paths come from the loaded skill's own version; the secret guard is documented in adoption.md, not shipped as a plugin hook.
